description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific image upgrade procedures for an embedded Linux device, including image validation, copying configuration, and performing full system upgrades with disk partition adjustments.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of an image to determine if a full write or an in-place upgrade is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the designated partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process, including partition layout comparison, bootloader updates, and writing image partitions.
